subject.title: fix(gateway): keep worker bootstrap failure details UTF-16 safe

question: After the regression is corrected, should the deterministic caller-level proof receive `proof: override`, or must the contributor demonstrate the failure through a real SSH worker bootstrap?
rationale: Repository review policy treats tests and injected runners as supplemental rather than real-behavior proof, while the maintainer closeout states that live SSH was unnecessary because transport and scripts are unchanged.

options.title: Override After Test Fix
options.body: Accept the corrected caller-level regression as sufficient for this pure shared error-projection change and apply an explicit proof override.

options.title: Require Live Worker Proof
options.body: Require a redacted terminal transcript or logs from a real worker bootstrap failure crossing the surrogate boundary.

recommendation.title: Override After Test Fix
recommendation.body: Accept the corrected caller-level regression as sufficient for this pure shared error-projection change and apply an explicit proof override.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the affected projection, authored the current-head test refactor, and already assessed the necessity of live SSH proof.
